name: After § 22
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 22c. Calls on the Commission to make a new proposal to introduce a luxury carbon tax on luxury goods, including yachts, private jets and SUVs, as a new own resource; recalls that such a tax would be socially just, help mitigate climate change and could be more effective than a classic carbon tax;
